focus: Verify the top deletion candidates against live enforcement, checker identity and hidden coverage
noveltyJustification: 6 of 7 findings were new verification results (unprotected branch, identical checker paths, naming guard hidden tests, bypass surface, no manifest, checkout-only saving) and 1 restates iteration 7 pricing.
keyQuestions: Which CI workflows duplicate a local hook, another workflow, or a guard that fires no unique regression, and how many minutes does each remove per push or PR?
ruledOut: Claiming CI is unnecessary because hooks exist

No gate inventory enumerates the candidate workflows, so deletion needs no manifest update
